name: @muon3d/printer-client
description: What every client of a Muon3D printer shares, without a framework: the status words, the printer directory and page slugs Muon3D Control uses; the local network checks; central sign-in, the account service and a refresh-safe session; a printer through the relay; the checks before a send; the upload body and the gateway rules it is checked against; the error kinds, their parsers and the plain words a person reads about each.
